newsitem.title: USA: KinderCare merger price reduced to $19/shr.
newsitem.headline: KinderCare merger price reduced to $19/shr.

text.p: KinderCare Learning Centers Inc said that it and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co have amended their merger agreement, lowering the price for KinderCare stock to $19.00 a share, from the $20.25 a share in the original agreement.
KinderCare said that the amendment follows an assessment by KKR of KinderCare's recent business performance. It made the statement Friday after business hours.

In November, KinderCare reported earnings for its first quarter, or the sixteen weeks ended September 20, 1996 of $0.09 a share after a $0.06 charge for early extinguishment of debt, compared to earnings of $0.17 a share the previous first quarter.
The other terms of the transaction remain unchanged from the original agreement.

In October, KinderCare said it had a definitive agreement to merge with an affiliate of KKR, where shareholders would receive $20.25 in cash for each share, or would retain existing KinderCare common stock.

The election to retain stock remains subject to proration so that about 93 percent of the outstanding KinderCare shares are exchanged for cash and about seven percent would be retained by existing shareholders.
If the merger is consummated, a KKR-controlled entity would own about 85 percent of KinderCare and KinderCare's pre-merger shareholders would own about 15 percent.
